moves.speaker: William Lane Craig
moves.claim: Craig defines the Christian God through Jesus and offers five lines.
moves.warrant: The lines include cosmology, design, morality, resurrection, and experience.
moves.inference: Together they aim at Christian theism.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: God who has revealed himself decisively in Jesus of Nazareth

moves.speaker: William Lane Craig
moves.claim: The universe began and has a personal cause.
moves.warrant: Beginning evidence and exclusion of abstract causes support this.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: the cause of the universe is a transcendent personal mind

moves.speaker: William Lane Craig
moves.warrant: Necessity and chance are rejected.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: therefore it is due to design

moves.speaker: William Lane Craig
moves.claim: Objective morality exists and requires God.
moves.warrant: Mind-independent wrongness is asserted.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: objective values do exist and deep down we all know it

moves.speaker: William Lane Craig
moves.warrant: Empty tomb, appearances, and belief are cited.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: three established facts recognized by the majority of New Testament historians today

moves.speaker: Andrew Pyle
moves.warrant: He adopts a critical agnostic posture.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: I'm here to rebut Professor Craig's arguments

moves.speaker: Andrew Pyle
moves.warrant: Incompatible traditions lack an independent test.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: do we have any criterion of correctness for religious experience

moves.speaker: Andrew Pyle
moves.warrant: Flourishing, welfare, and reason are offered.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: None of these theories requires God

moves.speaker: Andrew Pyle
moves.warrant: Goodness must precede command.
moves.inference: Divine command does not ground value.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: we need an independent standard of what is good and what is bad

moves.speaker: Andrew Pyle
moves.claim: A cause does not identify God.
moves.warrant: Useful causal hypotheses have independent content.
moves.inference: The divine label is ad hoc.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: the causal hypothesis is entirely ad hoc

moves.speaker: Andrew Pyle
moves.claim: Local sensitivity does not show global improbability.
moves.warrant: Remote parameter regions are unknown.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: there might be lots and lots and lots of universes that permit

moves.speaker: Andrew Pyle
moves.warrant: Loop cosmology is qualified as uncertain.
moves.inference: Predictive rivals are not merely ad hoc.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: Can we test this hypothesis

moves.speaker: William Lane Craig
moves.warrant: Neither premise was refuted.
moves.inference: Prediction is irrelevant to the deduction.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: given the two premises, the conclusion follows with logical necessity

moves.speaker: William Lane Craig
moves.warrant: The fly analogy and multiverse objections are offered.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: it is much more probable that the bullet would miss the fly

moves.speaker: William Lane Craig
moves.warrant: Craig rejects voluntarism.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: God's own nature is the paradigm of moral goodness

moves.speaker: Andrew Pyle
moves.claim: Resurrection sources and alternatives need scrutiny.
moves.warrant: Delay, error, and rival hypotheses are cited.
moves.inference: Empty tomb does not entail resurrection.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: list naturalistic hypotheses, eliminate naturalistic hypotheses

moves.speaker: William Lane Craig
moves.claim: Historical criteria support the facts and context identifies the miracle.
moves.warrant: Attestation, embarrassment, and Jewish context are invoked.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: they have criteria of authenticity to determine what does and does not belong

moves.speaker: Andrew Pyle
moves.claim: Naturalism has an inductive track record.
moves.warrant: Many anomalous reports prove natural or fraudulent.
moves.inference: An unexplained case need not be supernatural.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: naturalism has a great deal going for it

moves.speaker: Andrew Pyle
moves.warrant: Known persons act across time.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: I'm not really sure that I even understand what it would be to be a timeless person

moves.speaker: William Lane Craig
moves.claim: Generic arguments reach monotheism while resurrection reaches Christianity.
moves.warrant: Craig explicitly limits the first three arguments.
moves.inference: The exact motion depends on resurrection.
moves.sourceSpanSelectionRationale: Smallest complete passage for this distinct move.
quoteEligibleExactSpans: It's not until you get to the resurrection of Jesus
